title: Bottled Levels
description: A refillable XP bottle that stores up to 30 levels (tweakable in the config file or through ModMenu). Fill it by holding right-click, drink it to get your XP back.
body:
# 🧪 Bottled Levels

Ever lost your XP to a creeper explosion? **Bottled Levels** lets you store your hard-earned experience in a refillable bottle and take it out whenever you need it.

## ✨ Features

- **7 visual stages** — the bottle fills up as you store more levels
- **Hold Shift + right-click** to fill the bottle one level at a time
- **Drink** the bottle to get your XP back instantly
- **Stackable** — bottles at the same level stack together
- **Empty bottle returned** to your inventory after use
- **Sound effects** on fill, drink, and when the bottle is full
- **Craft** with 4× Lapis Lazuli around a Glass Bottle

## ⚙️ Config (ModMenu)

- Toggle drink mode (hold to drink vs instant)
- Set the max number of levels per bottle (default: 30)
- Toggle stackable bottles on/off

## 📦 Dependencies

- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API
- ModMenu (optional, for in-game config)

## 🌐 Contact me

- Create a **git issue** if you want a specific version or if you have an issue with the mod or a **compatibility issue** with another mod
- By discord **"zazacttv"** for any request on another vibe coded mod
